title: Tesla: Electrical Genius
description: The brilliant inventor who illuminated the modern world with alternating current and wireless technology
imageHint: ⚡ The wizard of electricity and wireless power ⚡

questions.question: What type of electrical current did Tesla champion that became the standard for power transmission?
questions.hint: It's abbreviated as AC and changes direction periodically

questions.question: Which famous inventor and businessman was Tesla's rival in the 'War of Currents'?
questions.hint: He invented the light bulb and preferred direct current (DC)

questions.question: What is the name of the rotating magnetic field principle that Tesla discovered, crucial to AC motors?
questions.hint: It involves magnetic fields that spin around in a circle

questions.question: Tesla demonstrated wireless power transmission at which famous laboratory location?
questions.hint: A mountainous state's springs-named city where he created artificial lightning

questions.question: What ambitious wireless transmission tower did Tesla build on Long Island that was never completed?
questions.hint: Named after the benefactor James S. Warden, it was meant to transmit power wirelessly across the Atlantic

deeperMode.title: Tesla's Obsessive Inventions
deeperMode.description: Dive into the mind of a genius who claimed to communicate with Mars and predicted smartphones

questions.question: Tesla had an obsessive fear of this round object and refused to touch jewelry containing them.
questions.hint: Formed inside oysters, these smooth spherical gems disturbed his sense of symmetry

questions.question: What did Tesla call his theoretical wireless communication device that predicted modern smartphones?
questions.hint: He envisioned a global network where people could communicate instantly anywhere
